messages:
marta_support: forwarding a customer ticket from Acme — they say their assistant dropped the initial system sentence after yesterday's runtime change. attached before/after and payload.

marta_support: customer payload (redacted):
```
POST /v1/chat
model=redwood-large-v1
messages=[
  {"role":"system","content":"You are an expert legal assistant.\nPlease be concise."},
  {"role":"user","content":"Describe the termination clauses for contract X."}
]
```

marta_support: BEFORE (what customer expected):
"As an expert legal assistant, I would note that contract X..."

marta_support: AFTER (what they saw):
"I would note that contract X..."  <-- leading system phrase missing

jordan_ml: thanks, sending to infra. my quick hypothesis: the new chat-template normalizer collapsed the punctuation+newline sequence in system messages and that removed an explicit token boundary the tokenizer relied on.

jordan_ml: repro I ran locally:
```
# old runtime (pre-change)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.host/v1/chat \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-large-v1","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are an expert legal assistant.\nPlease be concise."},{"role":"user","content":"Describe the termination clauses for contract X."}]}'
# generation includes the explicit system-prefix tokens in sampling

# new runtime (with normalize_chat_preamble=true)
# same payload, but the runtime collapsed "\n" and trimmed separators; sampled text omitted the explicit prefix
```

jordan_ml: tokenization inspection (abbreviated):
```
old_tokens: [11, 402, 9001, ...]  // contains SYS_MARK + token for "You"
new_tokens: [11, 402, ...]      // "You" merged/shifted causing prefix token to be absent for conditioning
```

priya_eng: deploy-bot shows rollout id rollout/2026-03-01-chat-normalize-flag. we toggled normalize_chat_preamble=true to reduce noise.

kai_oncall: can we confirm this is limited to system message endings with punctuation followed by newline? sounds like a corner-case where collapse removed a delimiter token.

jordan_ml: confirmed — reproduced when system content ends with ".\n". collapsing to "." removes an explicit separator token. that changes the token offsets used during sampling and can drop the full sentence prefix in generated text.

priya_eng: mitigation options:
- flip normalize_chat_preamble back to false for affected pools (fast live config revert)
- implement a compatibility shim that inserts an explicit separator token (e.g., " <|sep|> ") when detection patterns match

priya_eng: i'll flip the flag on dedicated-prod-US first. config flips are instant (~30s). will post the flip id.

deploy-bot: configFlip/1768601800-revert-normalize applied to pool=dedicated-prod-us

priya_eng: flipped normalize_chat_preamble=false on the pool. can support test with the customer's payload?

marta_support: re-tested with Acme — they confirm the system preface is back in sampled outputs. customer relieved but requests an incident writeup and preventative test. :relieved:

jordan_ml: next steps:
- add a regression eval in the eval-harness to detect preamble presence across normalizers/tokenizers
- update tokenizer normalizer to preserve explicit punctuation+newline separators (safer default)
- include a checklist item for template-normalizer toggles in rollout playbook

kai_oncall: filing INC-2026-042 to track remediation; assigning jordan_ml and priya_eng.

sam_customer_success: i'll send Acme a summary and offer 72h monitoring. will CC on postmortem.

marta_support: leaving thread open until the PR lands and the regression test is in CI.
